name: thinwood
description: Verbatim, locally-scored context compaction for Claude Code, using a model running in Ollama instead of a paid API.

baseUrl.title: Ollama base URL
baseUrl.description: Base URL of the local Ollama server.

model.title: Ollama model
model.description: Ollama model used to score keep/drop decisions.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

compactAtTokens.title: Compaction token threshold
compactAtTokens.description: Request compaction once the context reaches this many tokens (0 disables). Works in headless/Desktop sessions too. Compaction also triggers at compactAtPercent, whichever comes first.

trimResults.title: Trim large tool results
trimResults.description: Shrink large tool results (ANSI/progress noise, repeats, a cut middle) before the session keeps them; the full output is saved to ~/.claude/trimmed-results.

trimTools.title: Tools to trim
trimTools.description: Comma-separated tool names whose results may be trimmed. Read and WebFetch are left out by default because exact text matters there.

trimThresholdChars.title: Trim threshold (chars)
trimThresholdChars.description: Results longer than this are trimmed (errors get three times the allowance).

trimVerbose.title: Log each trim
trimVerbose.description: Print a line in the transcript every time a result is trimmed.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every local request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one local request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when the model decides its full output is no longer needed.

maxCallsPerRequest.title: Tool calls per request
maxCallsPerRequest.description: Most tool calls scored in one request to the local model. Each is two questions, and a request must finish within the plugin sandbox's 30 s limit.

minResultChars.title: Smallest result to score
minResultChars.description: Tool results shorter than this are kept without asking the model, since dropping them saves almost nothing.

minScoreSpread.title: Minimum score spread
minScoreSpread.description: If the first request's scores differ by less than this, the model can't tell what to drop and the built-in summary is used right away.

scoring.title: Scoring method
scoring.description: 'reuse' (default) ranks old tool results by how the assistant has used them: instant, no model, no network. 'model' asks the local Ollama model about every call (slow; a 14B model scored nearly everything the same).

dropFraction.title: Share of old results to drop
dropFraction.description: With 'reuse': the share of old tool-result text to truncate, 0 to 1. Higher frees more but drops results the assistant may still want (about 8% of later-reused results lost at 0.5, about 25% at 0.7 in the author's tests).

minInputChars.title: Long input threshold (chars)
minInputChars.description: A string field in an old tool call's input (a Write body, an Edit's text, a long command) is cut once it is at least this long.

inputDropFraction.title: Share of long inputs to cut
inputDropFraction.description: 0 to 1. The oldest long inputs are cut first until this share of their text is gone; 0 keeps every input.

saveDropped.title: Save what compaction cuts
saveDropped.description: Write the full text of every truncated result and input under ~/.claude/thinwood-saved and name the file in the marker, so nothing is lost.

pruneBeforeSummary.title: Prune before the built-in summary
pruneBeforeSummary.description: When too little can be cut to skip the summary, still hand the summary the pruned history so it has less to read.

protectRecentMessages.title: Recent messages never cut
protectRecentMessages.description: Tool results in this many of the latest messages are never truncated by the reuse scorer.
